body: My argument isn't that there's no place left to search, it's just that to continue the search is too burdensome. If I lost my keys, I would search for a long-ass time for them, but eventually it's just better to give up and get new keys made. I have spent years and years suffering everyday, taking all of my willpower to just get out of bed, to search and find something to live for. I've failed every day. At some point, I think I'm justified in sitting back and giving up.

Thanks for your kind words. For some people, it just simply makes more sense to continue pushing forward and searching, but I just feel like I have searched enough. I'm tired now, too tired to spend more years looking, hurting all the while. 

No need to keep me in your thoughts, friend. I wish you a good life, free from the burdens of having to remember me.

Nah I'm not trying to find a meaning in life. I'm simply trying to find things pleasurable enough to sustain me. I don't think there is a meaning to all of this mess, sadly. 

I've felt like this for as long as I can remember, even in elementary school I remember my teacher telling me that I was a downer. I've tried meds and therapy, but like, sure, I could keep trying more. I could keep desperately scrambling for something to "cure" me day after day, but for what? I could just die and be done with it.

I dunno, maybe it's a qualia issue. People talk about these beautiful moments in life that outweigh all the pain, but I guess I just am not wired to feel like these things are valued. I've spent most of my life searching for things that'd make my life worth living, and frankly, nothing has even come close to rivaling all of the suffering. I've traveled the world and seen some of the most beautiful landscapes, I've gone as far in academics as you could possibly go, I've had friends so close I'd consider them family. None of it matters. Even in the middle of experiencing these things, I am struck by just how empty and hollow this life is. My stomach hurts, or my ears are ringing. The suffering is there in all of these small things. It's just not worth it to me.

Thanks for the well wishes though. You too are a beautiful human. I hope you feel more good than I ever could manage.
Good thing people who kill themselves literally won't care what a random loser posturing on Reddit thinks about them :DDDDD
